text:
alice: bringing up 'atlas-11b:int4+q' on canary. quick sanity longprefill shows small but growing token shift after ~11.5k tokens. filing here.
ben: outline the repro steps?
alice: run: `./eval_longprefill --model atlas-11b:int4+q --max-tokens 16384 --prompt-file tests/longprefill/simple_repeat.json`
alice: baseline fp16 vs int4: matches until ~11,520 tokens, then int4 starts producing repeated noun phrases and BLEU drops ~0.06.
carla: do we have KV dumps around 11.5k? also any kernel fallbacks in logs?
alice: grabbed kvdump and kernel log snippet. kvdump:
```
[11516] shard0 idx=11516 key=0xab12... len=1024
[11517] shard0 idx=11517 key=0xab56... len=1024
[11518] shard0 idx=11518 key=0xab98... len=1024
[11519] shard0 idx=11519 key=0xabcd... len=1024
[11520] shard0 idx=-11516 key=0x0000... len=0   <-- bad wrap
```
kernel log:
```
[2026-11-05T09:12:34Z] kernel(ptx-int4)::rotary_scale=0.997 fallback_on_precision_mismatch
[2026-11-05T09:12:34Z] kernel(ptx-int4)::using index_pack=int16_delta
```
carla: index=-11516 indicates signed overflow; int16 delta packing will wrap negative when window_base changes. we hit >11k tokens so delta exceed bounds in this packing scheme.
ben: didn't we have ticket about index shorting for memory on transfers? that used int16 to save bandwidth.
zeke: yes, PR #4890 introduced int16 delta packing for quant kernels to reduce PCIe transfer size. it assumed context windows < 8k, so this is a regression for long-context onboarding.
carla: quick mitigation: fallback to using the 32-bit packing header when max_context > 8k; also normalize rotary_scale to 1.0 for any fallback kernels so we don't get both scale and index discrepancies.
alice: can someone patch the runtime to detect max_context and force u32 deltas for kernels with longprefill tests? also add a CI gating test for 16k-longprefill.
ben: i'll open a small compatibility PR that marks the int16 packing as opt-in when context<=8192. adds asserts and a metric `prefill.kv.packed_delta_out_of_range`.
ben: https://github.com/redwood/inference/pull/6122 - adds context-aware packing, runtime assert, and a flag `--allow-int16-delta` default false for canary.
deploy-bot: [deploy] started canary patch deploy (id: d-8811)
alice: rerun after patch - initial results: FP16 and int4 outputs align up to 16k tokens in preliminary run. BLEU and perplexity differences within noise.
carla: long-term we should avoid implicit size optimizations that aren't validated by the onboarding checklist. adding a doc note: "packing delta width must be validated vs expected model context window + growth headroom".
zeke: also add unit tests for `kv_pack` to simulate window shifts and ensure no signed wrap.
ben: noted. i'll add tests and the metric alert threshold to the longprefill job so any wrap triggers an alarm.
alice: thanks all. will ship onboarding checklist update and follow-up with nightly 24k run.
carla: small follow-up: some shards still logged `rotary_scale=0.997` due to older kernel ABI; we need to normalize kernel ABI selection during rollout. adding a job to map kernel versions to models to ensure consistency.
alice: created onboarding ticket INF-2741 to capture fixes and docs.
ben: adding a short blurb in model-onboarding: "When enabling quant packing optimizations, run full longprefill up to target_context * 1.5 to detect pack delta overflows."
alice: great. closing thread for now, will post bench results tomorrow. :white_check_mark:
